entities.name: Q72N73
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to the supplied 324-aa protein; reviewed UniProt quinolinate synthase from Leptospira interrogans.
Catalyzes iminoaspartate plus dihydroxyacetone phosphate to form quinolinate (EC 2.5.1.72).
Binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit; annotated cytoplasmic.

entities.name: NAD+ biosynthesis
observations: Quinolinate synthase participates in de novo NAD+ biosynthesis from L-aspartate.
